title: Remove settingsValuesEqual flat formatter alias
summary: Removed the remaining flat window.settingsValuesEqual formatter alias while preserving settingsValuesEqual on window.mediaPipelineFormatters, switched settingsView to namespace-first formatter access, and refreshed WebView generated baselines/inventories. Regeneration exposed a stale rerun Plan CSV control classification, so the command-boundary guard now classifies rerun live, dry-run, and plan-only buttons as backend-owned /api/rerun/start controls and the DOM inventories include rerun-plan-only-button.
reason: The active WebView backlog calls for opportunistic reduction of transitional flat window.* exports by touched domain while preserving intentional test hooks and validating with static/browser evidence.
behavior_before: settingsValuesEqual was available both through window.mediaPipelineFormatters and as a transitional flat window.settingsValuesEqual alias. settingsView read the flat alias first. The WebView command-boundary generator did not classify the existing rerun-plan-only-button as a backend-owned rerun control, and the active DOM ID inventory was missing that rendered ID.
behavior_after: settingsValuesEqual remains available through window.mediaPipelineFormatters only; settingsView consumes that namespace with the same JSON fallback. The global export inventory total drops from 730 to 729 and formatters.js drops from 5 to 4 flat aliases. The command-boundary audit classifies rerun start, dry-run, and plan-only controls as backend-owned /api/rerun/start controls, and DOM generated/active inventories include rerun-plan-only-button.
manual_validation: npm run webview:commands - passed after rerun plan-only route classifier update; regenerated docs/generated/WEBVIEW_COMMAND_BOUNDARY_AUDIT.json
npm run webview:script-order:smoke - passed; loaded 138 WebView scripts
npm run webview:lint - passed with existing warnings and 0 errors
npm run webview:prework:check - blocked at webview:lint:budget:check; existing warning-budget drift reports complexity 108 > 101, max-lines-per-function 37 > 33, no-unused-vars 147 > 146
rollback_plan: Restore the flat window.settingsValuesEqual assignment, switch settingsView back to the prior flat-alias lookup, revert the rerun button command-boundary classifier and DOM/global export inventory updates, regenerate WebView baselines/summaries, and rerun the same WebView static/browser checks.
